fields.office: National Weather Service St. Louis MO
fields.headline: ...RIVER FLOOD POTENTIAL THROUGH THE WEEKEND...
areas: Cedar River from Milford to Riverbend
discussion: Heavy rain of 2 to 4 inches is expected across the Cedar River basin Friday night into Saturday. Soils are already wet and the river is running above normal.
Minor flooding is possible along the Cedar River by early next week. The chance of moderate flooding depends on where the heaviest rain falls.

forecastPoints.forecast: Rise to near 11 ft by Sunday
Rise to near 13.5 ft by Monday

fields.impacts: At 14 feet, water covers Mill Road at the low-water crossing.
fields.nextUpdate: The next hydrologic outlook will be issued Friday morning.
